verdict.rationale: Letta's memory system is file/Markdown-based (MemFS) and the mobile demo app mentions 'image attachments' in conversations, suggesting some file-based memory support, but there is no explicit documentation of storing PDFs or images as persistent memory inputs that can be recalled later. Missing for 10: explicit PDF ingestion into memory, documented image-to-memory storage/recall workflow, and any hands-on confirmation of recall accuracy from such files.
